title: 3 snack vending machines in US offices and gyms

source.text: Buying 3 snack vending machines and placing them in offices and gyms. Launch country US, budget $10,000, 8 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug vending-machines.

problem: Office workers and gym members want a quick snack on site.
customer: Location hosts: office managers and gym owners in the US who would let an operator place a snack machine (end buyers: their staff and members)
solution: Buy 3 snack vending machines and place them in offices and gyms.
assumptions: Used/refurbished snack machines (~USD 1,900 each) with a Nayax card reader, because new machines were not priced and the budget is USD 10,000.
Average vend ticket USD 2.01 (Cantaloupe 2026) and cost of goods ~50% of revenue (The Hustle operator survey).
Location commission 10% of gross; base gross USD 250 per machine per month (below the survivor-biased survey average of USD 309).
No location is secured yet; the founder pitches sites by walk-in and phone.
Founder time valued at USD 25/hour for CAC.
Headless run: no intake questions asked (user said just go).

answers.question: Is any location already secured?
answers.effect: Headless run: assumed no location secured; channel_readiness 2.
